content:
Hello! I'm trying to run comparator on a project that uses bv_decide. I use the command recommended in comparator's Readme:

systemd-run --property=RestrictAddressFamilies=~AF_UNIX --user --pty -E PATH="$PATH" --working-directory $(pwd) -- bash -c 'lake env path/to/comparator/binary path/to/config.json'

The error I get is:

error: Lemmas.lean:12:2: permission denied (error code: 13)

I think this happens because bv_decide wants to write into /tmp and the sandbox does not allow that.

Note that the proof I would like to verify does not even use bv_decide: The bv_decide call is used for other theorems in the project that I don't need to check via comparator.

Is this a known issue? I couldn't find any issue on GitHub or thread on Zulip.
Yes, that works! But I guess not as safe as the system-run variant?

I would say it is approximately at the same level as what is currently documented in the github repo variant, it ships a sandbox based on bwrap instead of landrun that is configured to prevent the specific exploits that the systemd-run + landrun was designed with in mind.
Ah, cool, that's great. I didn't know about that. Maybe you want to mention lake comparator in the comparator readme?
With due time, it's only available in a release candidate at the moment^^
I see. Is there a way to make it work for projects on an older Lean version?
In principle you can override the lean4export it uses
Hm, seems tricky. I guess I'll wait until the project is on the newest Lean version. Thanks!
